title: Xbox is officially embracing the chaos of AI-powered game ports
script:
Xbox is officially embracing AI to help port classic games to new devices.
Retro gaming is surging through code decompilations and recompilations on modern hardware.
Microsoft witnessed skateboarding modded into Call of Duty and Halo playing inside a web browser.
Xbox Labs is leading this exploration into advanced emulation and automated code ports.
Developers are merging code from two separate games into a single new experience using these tools.
Would you play classic console titles ported entirely by AI?

editor.one_line: Misleading framing of experimental research as official product strategy; visuals are repetitive and low-effort.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Change 'Xbox is officially embracing' to 'Xbox Labs is experimenting with AI-assisted code porting'.
LINE 4: Remove 'leading this exploration' and focus on the specific research project mentioned in the source.
LINE 6: Change 'ported entirely by AI' to 'ported using AI-assisted tools' to maintain technical accuracy.
visual_notes: line 1: The same static image is held for over 7 seconds, violating the pacing rule.
line 2: Visuals are just text on a black background; lacks relevant imagery of retro gaming or cod
line 3: The 'Call of Duty' and 'Halo' logos are missing; using generic 'A' icons is lazy.
line 4: The Verge logo is used as a placeholder for Xbox Labs, which is confusing and inaccurate.
line 5: Visuals are static and repetitive, failing to illustrate the concept of merging game code.
